event_counts.clarification: The raw O01 count is 80 and all 80 precede Sep30. The final O01 event is Sep28, not Sep30. That event can submit on Sep29 but cannot complete h5 in-window. Prior 79-label count excludes this late event; it is not the usable entry-signal count.

caveats: Each planned cycle can create at most one closed actual transaction. Limit misses, insufficient lots and delayed fills reduce attainable actual count.
Bounds with risk_exit=False and trailing_stop=0 apply only to fixed planned holding. Early risk/trailing exits can relax long-hold bounds but cannot exceed h1 optimistic bound.
For all-day always opportunity, fixed-h upper bound is floor(1534/(h+1)); every hold>=12 is impossible for 128 closed cycles without early exits.
For opportunity families below128 usable events or below128 h1 closed-cycle capacity, no premium/allocation/longer holding/cooldown can fix density.
No nominal high-frequency opportunity expansion is licensed by this capacity audit; any component redefinition requires successor experiment and independent effect diagnostics.

suggested_search.screen: Compute and register feature-only density bound for every proposed config before real-return evaluation; report bound-pruned trials rather than silently dropping them.
suggested_search.families: Search n09 and union first; o01/Q07 remain component attribution controls, cannot be standalone frequency-qualified candidates.
notes: Do not Cartesian-expand this entire list; begin cost/fill/hold contrasts, then a seeded compact Optuna successor with an explicit trial budget.
